scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @salesos/shared-types --filter @salesos/validation --filter @salesos/platform-core run build && pnpm --filter @salesos/crm-core run build && pnpm --filter @salesos/cx-core run build && pnpm --filter @salesos/workforce-core run build
